docs.summary: The stages of one build and their ordering constraints.
docs.remarks: Built per request rather than per pipeline, because the shape genuinely changes with the request. A desktop build that embeds assets into the assembly has to process them before the player project is generated, while one that packs them alongside has to wait until after publish, since publish clears the output directory. Those are different graphs from the same pipeline.

docs.summary: Validates that no stage is declared twice, all dependencies exist in the graph, and there are no cycles. Throws ArgumentException when any of those conditions is violated.
Stages whose dependencies are all in `completed` and which have not run.
A dependency respecting order, or null when the graph has a cycle.
